shadow_lab.title: Field trial — two virtual Johnny scenarios
shadow_lab.description: No wallbox commands. Two always-charging synthetic EVs (wide and medium margin) observe only household Shelly sensors. Private JSONL files are written under /config/easywallbox_smart_shadow/. Initial power is reserved for future sessions; the continuous trial assumes maximum EV power. DPM=0 uses an explicitly labeled test model.
